children: Two exchange-traded funds linked to Palantir Technologies
carried reported exposure of roughly twice the stock's value as the shares retreated more than 7% ahead of Tuesday's market open.
recorded a 200.4% swap weighting. Leverage Shares 2X Long PLTR Daily ETF (PLTG) followed with 199.90% exposure through combined swaps tied to Palantir.

The two products had the largest reported exposures among 571 ETFs with investments linked to the software company. Their swap-based positions represent leveraged exposure rather than direct ownership of an equivalent percentage of Palantir shares.

Other funds had considerably smaller reported weightings. FT Vest PLTR & Target Income ETF (XVPT) held 50.07% exposure, while Direxion Daily PLTR Bull 2X ETF (PLTU) and Corgi Data & Surveillance ETF (EYES) reported 17.81% and 14.79%, respectively.

The stock's retreat came despite Palantir delivering third-quarter results above Wall Street expectations and improving its full-year outlook. Investor attention instead turned to slower U.S. commercial bookings, which appeared to overshadow the company's quarterly performance.

title: Palantir Sell-Off Sends Shockwaves Through ETFs With Massive Stock Exposure
